strTaniumEpiDir = GetClientDir() & "Tools\EPI\" strExeName = "TaniumEndpointIndex.exe" strExecWrapper = strTaniumEpiDir & "TaniumExecWrapper.exe"
Set fso = WScript.CreateObject("Scripting.Filesystemobject") Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell") strDestFilePath = strTaniumEpiDir & strExeName
'default limit strLimit="10"
bTreatAsRegex = False strTreatAsRegex = UTF8Decode("||treatInputAsRegex||") If Trim(strTreatAsRegex) = "1" Then bTreatAsRegex = CheckEPIRegexSupport(fso, objShell, strDestFilePath) End If strFileNameIn = UTF8Decode("||fileName||") strHashIn = UTF8Decode("||fileMD5Hash||") strHashSHA1In = UTF8Decode("||fileSHA1Hash||") strHashSHA256In = UTF8Decode("||fileSHA256Hash||")
'strTreatAsRegex = UTF8Decode("") strDirectoryPathIn = UTF8Decode("") 'strFileNameIn = UTF8Decode("*calc.exe") 'strSizeIn = UTF8Decode("") 'strHashIn = UTF8Decode("") 'strHashSHA1In = UTF8Decode("") 'strHashSHA256In = UTF8Decode("") strMagicNumberIn = UTF8Decode("") strLimitIn = UTF8Decode("10")
strDirectoryPath = GenerateValidQueryInput(strDirectoryPathIn,"*") strFileName = GenerateValidQueryInput(strFileNameIn,"*") strSize = GenerateValidQueryInput(strSizeIn,"*") strHash = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashIn,"*") strHashSHA1 = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashSHA1In,"*") strHashSHA256 = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashSHA256In,"*") strMagicNumber = GenerateValidQueryInput(strMagicNumberIn,"*") strLimit = GenerateValidQueryInput(strLimitIn,strLimit)
strUrlArg=" --url-encode-output" strOptionalArg="" If CheckEPIArgSupport(fso, objShell, strDestFilePath, strUrlArg)Then strOptionalArg=strUrlArg End If execed=ExeEPI(fso,objShell, strDestFilePath, strDirectoryPath, strFileName, strSize, strHash, strMagicNumber, strLimit, strOptionalArg)
Function ExeEPI(ByRef fso, ByRef objShell, ByVal strDestFilePath,ByVal strDirectoryPath, ByVal strFileName,ByVal strSize,ByVal strHash,ByVal strMagicNumber,ByVal strLimit,ByVal strOptionalArg) ExeEPI=False If (fso.FileExists(strDestFilePath))Then Dim oExec,strCmd,strOutput,strSelect,strParams,strlines,item,strfullPath,strOutputHash,strParse strSelect = "SELECT path || '\' || name as FileName, MD5, SHA1, SHA256 FROM vFiles WHERE" strSelect = strSelect & " FileId > 0"
call RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir(strDirectoryPath) If bTreatAsRegex Then ' Special prefix means we'll be using regular expressions, and therefore ' may need the '|' character inside actual parameter values. ' Use double pipes as the separator. strParams="@regex" call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath,"||") call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Name",strFileName,"||") call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Size",strSize,"||") call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"MD5",strHash,"||") call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"SHA1",strHashSHA1,"||") call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"SHA256",strHashSHA256,"||") call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"MagicNumber",strMagicNumber,"||") Else If IsSpecialDirectoryGlob(strDirectoryPath) Then call AppendSpecialDirectoryGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath) Else call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath) End If call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Name",strFileName) call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Size",strSize) call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"MD5",strHash) call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"SHA1",strHashSHA1) call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"SHA256",strHashSHA256) call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"MagicNumber",strMagicNumber) End If
strSelect = strSelect & " LIMIT " & strLimit
strCmd=Chr(34)& strDestFilePath &Chr(34)& strOptionalArg & " -psescape " &Chr(34)& "^" &Chr(34)& " -psprep " &Chr(34)& strSelect &Chr(34)& " -psparams " &Chr(34)& strParams &Chr(34) set oExec = TaniumExec(strCmd, False, 55, "", strExecWrapper, "") strOutput = strOutput & oExec.StdOut.ReadAll
strlines = split(strOutput,vbCrLf) for each item in strlines Dim fullline, strVersion, fso2, opath, omd5 , osha1,osha256,oversion,outputall if item <> Empty or item <> Null then fullline = split(item,"|") opath = Replace(UTF8Decode(fullline(0)), Chr(13), vbnullstring) omd5 = Replace(UTF8Decode(fullline(1)), Chr(13), vbnullstring) osha1 = Replace(UTF8Decode(fullline(2)), Chr(13), vbnullstring) osha256 = Replace(UTF8Decode(fullline(3)), Chr(13), vbnullstring) Set FSO2 = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") oversion = fso2.GetFileVersion(opath) wscript.echo opath & "|" & omd5 & "|" & osha1 & "|" & osha256 & "|" & oversion
end if next ExeEPI=True Else WScript.Echo "Error: Could not find Tanium Endpoint Index" End If End Function '------------ INCLUDES after this line. Function GetClientDir() Dim strResult
strResult = GetEnvironmentValue("TANIUM_CLIENT_ROOT")
If IsNull(strResult) Then Dim objSh strResult = "" Set objSh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
On Error Resume Next If strResult="" Then strResult=Eval("objSh.RegRead(""HKLM\Software\Tanium\Tanium Client\Path"")") : Err.Clear If strResult="" Then strResult=Eval("objSh.RegRead(""HKLM\Software\Wow6432Node\Tanium\Tanium Client\Path"")") : Err.Clear If strResult="" Then Err.Clear On Error Goto 0 End If
If strResult="" Then Call fRaiseError(5, "GetClientDir", _ "TSE-Error:Can not locate client directory", False)
If Right(strResult, 1) <> "\" Then strResult = strResult & "\"
GetClientDir = strResult End Function '- End file: utils/settings/GetClientDir.vbs '- Begin file: utils/RaiseError.vbs ' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=utils/RaiseError.vbs
Function fRaiseError(errCode, errSource, errorMsg, RaiseError) If RaiseError Then On Error Resume Next Call Err.Raise(errCode, errSource, errorMsg) Exit Function Else WScript.Echo errorMsg Wscript.Quit End If End Function '- End file: utils/RaiseError.vbs '- Begin file: utils/os/GetEnvironmentValue.vbs ' Returns the passed in environment variable value. Function GetEnvironmentValue(strName) Dim objShell, strSub, strResult Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell") strSub = "%" & strName & "%" strResult = objShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings(strSub)
If strResult = strSub Then GetEnvironmentValue = Null Else GetEnvironmentValue = strResult End If End Function ' GetEnvironmentValue '- End file: utils/os/GetEnvironmentValue.vbs '- Begin file: i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs '======================================== ' UTF8Decode '======================================== ' Used to convert the UTF-8 style parameters passed from ' the server to sensors in sensor parameters. ' This function should be used to safely pass non english input to sensors.
' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs
Function UTF8Decode(str) Dim arraylist(), strLen, i, sT, val, depth, sR Dim arraysize arraysize = 0 strLen = Len(str) for i = 1 to strLen sT = mid(str, i, 1) if sT = "%" then if i + 2 <= strLen then Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1) arraylist(arraysize) = cbyte("&H" & mid(str, i + 1, 2)) arraysize = arraysize + 1 i = i + 2 end if else Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1) arraylist(arraysize) = asc(sT) arraysize = arraysize + 1 end if next depth = 0 for i = 0 to arraysize - 1 Dim mybyte mybyte = arraylist(i) if mybyte and &h80 then if (mybyte and &h40) = 0 then if depth = 0 then Err.Raise 5 end if val = val * 2 ^ 6 + (mybyte and &h3f) depth = depth - 1 if depth = 0 then sR = sR & chrw(val) val = 0 end if elseif (mybyte and &h20) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h1f depth = 1 elseif (mybyte and &h10) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h0f depth = 2 else Err.Raise 5 end if else if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 sR = sR & chrw(mybyte) end if next if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 UTF8Decode = sR End Function '- End file: i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs '- Begin file: index/AppendWhereGlob.vbs Sub AppendWhereGlob(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal) If (StrComp("*", columnVal) <> 0) Then strSelect = strSelect & " AND " & columnName & " LIKE ?" If Len(strParams) <> 0 Then strParams = strParams + "|" End If strParams = strParams + GlobToLike(columnVal) End If End Sub
Sub AppendWhereRegex(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal, ByVal delimVal) If Len(columnVal) > 0 Then If (StrComp("*", columnVal) <> 0) Then If (StrComp(".*", columnVal) <> 0) Then strSelect = strSelect & " AND " & columnName & " REGEXP ?" strParams = strParams + delimVal strParams = strParams + Replace(columnVal, "^", "^^") End If End If End If End Sub
Sub AppendSpecialDirectoryGlob(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal) ' Strip off the trailing "\*" from the columnVal Dim bareDirectoryVal bareDirectoryVal = Left(columnVal, Len(columnVal) - 2) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (" & columnName & " = ? OR " & columnName & " LIKE ?)" If Len(strParams) > 0 Then strParams = strParams + "|" End If ' Add two parameter values, one for 'bare' directory path, and one with ' the trailing "slash-star" wildcard strParams = strParams & bareDirectoryVal & "|" strParams = strParams + GlobToLike(columnVal) End Sub
Sub AppendTimeSlice(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnVal) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (Created > ? OR Modified > ?)" If Len(strParams) <> 0 Then strParams = strParams + "|" End If strParams = strParams + CStr(columnVal) + "|" + CStr(columnVal) End Sub
Sub AppendTimeSliceRegex(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnVal, ByVal delimVal) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (Created > ? OR Modified > ?)" strParams = strParams + delimVal + CStr(columnVal) + delimVal + CStr(columnVal) End Sub
Function IsSpecialDirectoryGlob(ByVal strDirectoryParam) ' Regex search to see if directory parameter is something like ' C:\Users\* ' Where a trailing slash is followed by the star wildcard Dim specialRx Set specialRx = New RegExp specialRx.Global = True specialRx.IgnoreCase = True specialRx.Pattern = "^([A-Z]:\\[^\*\?]+)\\\*$" IsSpecialDirectoryGlob = specialRx.Test(strDirectoryParam) End Function
Function GlobToLike(byVal strGlob) GlobToLike = strGlob GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "^", "^^") GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "*", "^%") GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "?", "_") End Function '- End file: index/AppendWhereGlob.vbs '- Begin file: index/GenerateValidQueryInput.vbs Function GenerateValidQueryInput(ByVal strIn, ByVal strDefaultValue) If Len(strIn) = 0 Then If Len(strDefaultValue) = 0 Then GenerateValidQueryInput="*" Else GenerateValidQueryInput=strDefaultValue End If Else GenerateValidQueryInput = strIn End If End Function
Function GenerateValidRegexInput(ByVal strIn, ByVal strDefaultValue) If Len(strIn) = 0 Then If Len(strDefaultValue) = 0 Then GenerateValidRegexInput=".+" Else GenerateValidRegexInput=strDefaultValue End If Else GenerateValidRegexInput = strIn End If End Function '- End file: index/GenerateValidQueryInput.vbs '- Begin file: index/RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir.vbs Sub RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir(ByRef strDirectoryPath) Dim strDirectoryPathLen
strDirectoryPathLen = Len(strDirectoryPath) If strDirectoryPathLen > 1 Then If Right(strDirectoryPath, 1) = "\" Then strDirectoryPath = Left(strDirectoryPath, Len(strDirectoryPath)-1) End If End If End Sub '- End file: index/RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir.vbs '- Begin file: index/CheckEPIArgSupport.vbs Function CheckEPIArgSupport(ByRef fso, ByRef objShell, ByVal strDestFilePath, ByVal strOptionalArg) CheckEPIArgSupport=False If (fso.FileExists(strDestFilePath))Then Dim strCmd,strErrorCode
strCmd=Chr(34)&strDestFilePath&Chr(34)& strOptionalArg & " -v" strErrorCode = objShell.Run(strCmd,0,True) '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK If (strErrorCode="0")Then CheckEPIArgSupport=True End If End If End Function
Function CheckEPIRegexSupport(ByRef fso, ByRef objShell, ByVal strDestFilePath) CheckEPIRegexSupport=CheckEPIArgSupport(fso, objShell, strDestFilePath, "--regex-search") End Function '- End file: index/CheckEPIArgSupport.vbs '- Begin file: exec/TaniumExec.vbs

Function TaniumExec(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) 'Wraps and executes the Command_ via ExePath using Wscript.Shell.Exec(strCommand) ' 'Arguments: ' Command_ (string): Command and arguments to run ' RaiseError (boolean): If True, raise an error when an error is encountered. Otherwise, just print an error message and quit ' Timeout (int): Timeout in seconds (Default = 45) ' LogLevel (string): Log level (Default = "error") ' ExePath (string): Path to wrappper exe use (Default = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe") ' RedirectOutput (String or Array(2)): Path to redirect stdout if a non-empty String, or paths to stdout and stderr if an Array(2) 'Returns: ' Execution results object If Timeout = "" Then Timeout = 45 Dim strCommand: strCommand = TExecHelper(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) Set TaniumExec = (new MockWshScriptExec)(strCommand)
' ExitCode = 10 is encountered when the timeout is reaching, causing TaniumExecWrapper to kill the process If TaniumExec.ExitCode = 10 Then Dim errorMsg: errorMsg = "Timeout limit of " & Timeout & " second(s) reached and the process was killed: " & strCommand If RaiseError Then On Error Resume Next Call Err.Raise(6, "TaniumExec", errorMsg) '6 = "Overflow" Error Code Exit Function Else WScript.Echo errorMsg Wscript.Quit End If End If End Function 'TaniumExec '- End file: exec/TaniumExec.vbs '- Begin file: exec/TExecHelper.vbs

Function TExecHelper(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) 'Builds a command string intended to be executed via Wscript.Shell.Exec or Wscript.Shell.Run ' 'Arguments: ' Command_ (string): Command and arguments to run ' RaiseError (boolean): If True, raise an error when an error is encountered. Otherwise, just print an error message and quit ' Timeout (int): Timeout in seconds (Default = 45) ' LogLevel (string): Log level (Default = "error") ' ExePath (string): Path to wrappper exe use (Default = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe") ' RedirectOutput (String or Array(2)): Path to redirect stdout if a non-empty String, or paths to stdout and stderr if an Array(2) 'Returns: ' A command string Dim objFSO: Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
If ExePath = "" Then ExePath = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe"
If Not objFSO.FileExists(ExePath) Then Call fRaiseError(53, "TExecHelper", "Standard Utilities Missing: " & ExePath, RaiseError) '53 = "File not found" Error Code End If
'Set default values if not defined If Timeout = "" Then Timeout = 45 If LogLevel = "" Then LogLevel = "error"
Dim strCommand strCommand = Chr(34) & ExePath & Chr(34) strCommand = strCommand & " --timeout " & Timeout strCommand = strCommand & " --loglevel " & LogLevel
Dim valid: valid = False If TypeName(RedirectOutput) = "String" Then If Not RedirectOutput = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stdout-to """ & RedirectOutput & Chr(34) valid = True ElseIf TypeName(RedirectOutput) = TypeName(Array()) Then If UBound(RedirectOutput) = 1 Then If Not RedirectOutput(0) = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stdout-to """ & RedirectOutput(0) & Chr(34) If Not RedirectOutput(1) = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stderr-to """ & RedirectOutput(1) & Chr(34) valid = True End If ElseIf RedirectOutput = False Then valid = True End If
If Not valid Then Call fRaiseError(5, "TExecHelper", _ "RedirectOutput argument to TExecHelper must be a String or a Length-2 Array.", RaiseError) '5 = "Invalid procedure call or argument" Error Code End If
strCommand = strCommand & " -- " & Command_ TExecHelper = strCommand End Function 'TExecHelper '- End file: exec/TExecHelper.vbs '- Begin file: exec/MockWshScriptExec.vbs

Class MockTextStream Private text Private stream_read
Public Default Function Init(stream_content) Set Init = Me text = stream_content stream_read = False End Function
Public Property Get ReadAll If Not stream_read Then ReadAll = text stream_read = True Else ReadAll = "" End If End Property End Class
Class MockWshScriptExec Private stdout_: Public Property Get StdOut : Set StdOut = stdout_ : End Property Private stderr_: Public Property Get StdErr : Set StdErr = stderr_ : End Property Private exitcode_: Public Property Get ExitCode : ExitCode = exitcode_ : End Property
Public Default Function Init(strCommand) Set Init = Me Dim stdout_backer: Set stdout_backer=(new StreamBacker)("WScript.StdOut", False, True) Dim stderr_backer: Set stderr_backer=(new StreamBacker)("WScript.StdErr", False, True)
Dim objShell: Set objShell = CreateObject("Wscript.Shell") Dim realWshScriptExec: Set realWshScriptExec = objShell.Exec(strCommand) '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK
Do While realWshScriptExec.Status = 0 stdout_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdOut) stderr_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdErr) Loop stdout_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdOut) stderr_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdErr) stdout_backer.Stream.Position = 0 stderr_backer.Stream.Position = 0
Set stdout_ = (new MockTextStream)(stdout_backer.Stream.ReadText) Set stderr_ = (new MockTextStream)(stderr_backer.Stream.ReadText) exitcode_ = RealWshScriptExec.ExitCode End Function End Class '- End file: exec/MockWshScriptExec.vbs '- Begin file: exec/StreamBacker.vbs ' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=exec/StreamBacker.vbs
Class StreamBacker Private stream_ Private stdStream_ Public Property Get HasStdStream : HasStdStream=Not stdStream_ Is Nothing : End Property Public Property Get HasSelfStream : HasSelfStream=Not stream_ Is Nothing : End Property Public Property Get Stream : Set Stream=stream_ : End Property
Public Default Function Init(strName, bRedirectIfPossible, bStoreIfNotRedirected) Set Init=Me
Set stdStream_ = Nothing
If bRedirectIfPossible Then On Error Resume Next Set stdStream_=Eval(strName) If Err.Number<>0 Then Set stdStream_ = Nothing Err.Clear On Error Goto 0 End If
Set stream_=Nothing If Not HasStdStream And bStoreIfNotRedirected Then Set stream_ = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream") stream_.Charset="UTF-8" stream_.Open End If End Function
Sub Class_Terminate Set stream_ = Nothing Set stdStream_ = Nothing End Sub
Sub drainFrom(s) Do While Not s.AtEndOfStream Write s.Read(1024) Loop End Sub
Sub Write(s) If HasStdStream Then stdStream_.Write s ElseIf HasSelfStream Then stream_.WriteText s End If End Sub

meta_data_item.name: TANIUMCONTENT_description.en
meta_data_item.value: The Index Query File Path and Hash sensor supports supports both wildcards and regular expressions in parameters with the exception of the Maximum Number of Rows. Supported wildcard syntax includes the * character to match any number of characters and the ? character to match one character. For example, you can use *pad.exe to search for either notepad.exe or wordpad.exe. To use regular expressions in parameter values, make sure the Use Regular Expressions check box is selected. You can use regular expressions to search for more complex patterns and to further constrain the scope of the search. For example, specifying "C:\Program Files*\Tanium\*" as the Directory Path parameter and specifying "*.exe" as the File Name parameter searches for all executables located under the Tanium directory in either "Program Files" or "Program Files (x86)" on the C: drive.
